title: Existence of normalized tensor-exchange adjunction ingredients
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, coefficient datum $A$ with prime $\ell\ne p$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, positive $n$, a six-functor operation datum six, a separated finite-type map $f:X\to Y$ between finite-type schemes over $D.k$, a constructible exceptional-adjunction System $S$ and a compactification $c$ of $f$ [def-fix-six-functor-datum, def-sf-tensor-exchange-presentation]. There exists a Presentation $p$ of the three adjunctions and actual projection on the four coefficient stages, together with NormalizedDatum(six,S,c,p). This asserts no exchange isomorphism, exchange shift structure or coefficient-transposition identity.

proof.text: Restrict internal Hom, tensor, pullback and ordinary direct image to the actual full finite-Tor categories, using the finite Hom bounds and the uniform integral Hom/direct-image bounds. The finite direct-image corollary and pullback/tensor preservation ensure all intermediate inputs lie in these categories, including on nonseparated finite-type schemes.

The ringed closed adjunction has evaluation as counit. Integrally compose it with the completion-unit mapping property for complete Hom targets. Restrict the inverse proper/open projection and conjugate by the actual signed braidings. Retain all ringed and partial realization equations.

Localize these ingredients at every finite coefficient field, and realize common-stage objects and arrows at one finite field. Unique-adjoint transport identifies the chosen System functors and their transposes with the supplied datum. These constructions give the original-field equality and both field-stage ProjectionRealized equations. No exchange Conclusion is selected.
